Functions
cpct_getColorAtM0

Get the pen color of one pixel in Mode 0 (160x200, 16 colors).

C Definition

u8  cpct_getColorAtM0 (u8* vmem, u16 x, u16 y) __z88dk_callee;

Input Parameters
(2B HL)  vmem

Base VRAM memory address (typically 0xC000)

(2B DE)  x

E = X coordinate (0-159 no checks)

(2B BC)  y

C = Y coordinate (0-199 no checks)

Return value: (1B L) outColor - Pen color of pixel (0..15)

Assembly call:

call cpct_getColorAtM0_asm

Destroyed Register values: AF, BC, DE, HL

Comment Uses cpct_getScreenPtr_asm
